title: Etten/Gendringen 7 Squadron Stirling Memorial
memorial_details: Roadside sculpture and information board at Etten/Gendringen, Gelderland.
narrative: A 7 Squadron Stirling departed Oakington at 2017 on 26 March 1942 for Essen. The aircraft was coned for nine minutes by searchlights and then intercepted over Terborg by Oberleutnant Siegfried Wandam of 3/NJG1, shot down at 2300, his second claim. The aircraft crashed at Gendringen. All seven crew were killed. Notably, the Officer Commanding 7 Squadron was aboard as co-pilot.
cause_of_loss: Coned 9 minutes by searchlights; shot down by night fighter — Oblt Siegfried Wandam (3/NJG1), his 2nd claim
community_connection: The Officer Commanding 7 Squadron was on board as co-pilot and was killed in the crash.
notes: Serial number not given in source post — look up 7 Sqn Stirling lost 26/03/42 with OC aboard.
